postCreateCommand.core-tools: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jadx apktool mitmproxy tcpdump wireshark-common
postCreateCommand.dex2jar: sudo mkdir -p /opt/dex2jar && sudo wget -q -O /opt/dex2jar/dex-tools.zip https://github.com/pxb1988/dex2jar/releases/download/v2.4/dex-tools-2.4.zip && sudo unzip -q /opt/dex2jar/dex-tools.zip -d /opt/dex2jar && sudo rm /opt/dex2jar/dex-tools.zip && echo 'export PATH=\$PATH:/opt/dex2jar/dex-tools-2.4' >> ~/.bashrc
